summary: Aetherion Technologies Inc., formerly Westport Fuel Systems, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Management's Discussion and Analysis and condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, with exhibits incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. The filing is a routine quarterly reporting package by a Canadian foreign private issuer, containing no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor. No special-situation event is disclosed; the only notable item is the prior corporate name change. No deal terms or structural mechanics are presented, leaving no risk-arb angle to monitor.
